tip

tip

tip
Recklessness · 1 min 30 sec · +50% Rage generation and +20% crit chance for 12 seconds (duration +50% with Rampaging Berserker). Anger Management reduces it by 1 second per 20 Rage spent
tip
Avatar · 1 min 30 sec · +20% damage dealt for 20 seconds (Mountain Thane build)
tip
Bladestorm · 1 min 30 sec · Attacks nearby enemies for 4 seconds; immune to roots, snares, and crowd control (Slayer build)
aoe
Odyn's Fury · 45 sec · 12-yard AoE damage and bleed, Enrage (Slayer build)
tb

Defensive Stance · 15% less damage taken, 10% less damage dealt. Swap in right before big physical AoE and go back to Berserker Stance when it's over. With Stance Mastery, single hits for 20% or more of your max health are reduced by an extra 15% (Slayer build)
tb
Spell Reflection · 25 sec · 20% less magic damage taken for 5 seconds, reflects the first spell. Use it for every magic AoE (Wowhead)
tb
Impending Victory · 25 sec · Heals 30% max health
tip
Rallying Cry · 3 min · Increases max health of party members within 40 yards for 10 seconds (50% more outside of raids; Battlefield Commander adds 2% more and 3 more seconds)
int
Pummel · 15-second melee interrupt, locks that school for 5 seconds. 10% shorter cooldown with Honed Reflexes; on success, +5% damage to that enemy for 10 seconds
cc

Storm Bolt · 30 sec · 4-second stun at 20 yards. Shockwave · 40 sec · 2-second stun in a 10-yard frontal; Rumbling Earth adds 6 yards of range and cuts 15 seconds off the cooldown when it hits 3+ targets. Bosses are immune to both
pos

Heroic Leap · 45 sec (15 sec shorter with Bounding Stride, 70% movement speed for 3 seconds), Charge · 20 sec (2 charges and 3 sec shorter with Double Time). Get back in right after dodging a mechanic to keep your damage going
disp
Warriors have no ally dispel. Berserker Rage (1 min, 30 sec with Fearless) breaks your own fear, sap, and some incapacitates and removes snares
tip
Battle Shout gives the party 5% attack power. Interpose rushes to an ally and takes 30% of the damage dealt to allies within 3 yards (Slayer build)
tip
No battle res and no external defensives for allies. You have no cheat-death either, so take big hits with Defensive Stance and Spell Reflection ready in advance (Wowhead)
cc
Ascendant week: stop grouped orbs all at once with Shockwave, and scattered orbs with Storm Bolt and Pummel (Wowhead)
prio

pos
Pulsar week: run to the orbs, but don't drag your own orb far from the party. Regroup fast with Heroic Leap and Charge
tip
Devour week: the snare effect is removed by Berserker Rage (Fearless) (Wowhead). Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: each death costs 15 seconds

mountain-thane.title: Mountain Thane key points
items: Line up {Recklessness} and {Avatar} with big add packs and boss burst windows, and use the 2 {Thunder Blast} charges right after pressing them
Interrupt add pack casts with {Shockwave} and {Storm Bolt} (3 targets), and throw {Wrecking Throw} at shielded targets

slayer.title: Slayer key points
items: Line up {Recklessness} with big add packs and boss burst windows, and melt short-lived adds with {Odyn's Fury}
Interrupt add casts with {Pummel}, {Shockwave}, and {Storm Bolt}, and take big hits with {Defensive Stance} ready in advance

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Rallying Cry (3 min) with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone). Use any remaining Spell Reflection (25 sec) on the Carrion Burst Nature DoTs that stack every 3 sec during Ssscavenging (Topicx)
[참고] Pre-casting Spell Reflection as Triple Shot goes out reflects the glob aimed at you, leaving one less circle on the ground. Press it ahead of every Triple Shot (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. The Mountain Thane build throws Wrecking Throw (45 sec, up to 500% extra damage to absorb shields) at every shield and uses Avatar and Recklessness (1.5 min) on a shield whenever they are back. The Slayer build uses Odyn's Fury (45 sec) on every shield (Topicx)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Pummel (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts of Toxic Barrage, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes, press Recklessness with Bloodlust. Hit the grouped Writhes together with Avatar and Thunder Clap in the Mountain Thane build, or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm in the Slayer build (Topicx)

[제어] Stop a Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target, or one casting Toxic Atrophy, with Storm Bolt (4 sec stun) or Shockwave. During Death Rattle, snap the Vine Grip tether right away with Heroic Leap
Zul'jan: [위치] If your beam spot is far, reach it with Heroic Leap before the Ritual of the Fang channel. You take 38793 Nature every 1 sec while blocking the beam, so press Spell Reflection
[광역 피해] The group uses its defensives during the beam soak channel. Line Rallying Cry (3 min) up with this channel to survive Fang Empowered party damage (Topicx)

[회피] Dodge the Axegrinder axes, but when you deliberately clip a slowed axe to clear Ritual Venom, switch to Defensive Stance because the hit is armor-ignoring Physical damage. Top up the 7 sec Physical DoT left after clearing with Boneslicer using Impending Victory (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation. Kick it when Pummel (15 sec) is ready (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec. Go in with Spell Reflection up, and add Rallying Cry if the 8 sec Holy AoE of Lightbloom Overgrowth hits hard
[회피] When the beam ends, clear the Fertile Loam slow with Berserker Rage (Fearless) and leave the patch right away
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Rotate Spell Reflection on cooldown through Thorncaller Roar (Nature) and Lightcrazed Frenzy (Holy) after 50%, and use Rallying Cry during Frenzy
[참고] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx). Line up Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Bladestorm (Slayer build) at that point
[회피] If you are targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, use the Heroic Leap you saved to gain distance from the boss
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Pummel into the kick rotation for Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form

[위치] If marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still, aim the cone away from the group, and switch to Defensive Stance to take the 164870 Physical hits every 2 sec for 6 sec. If Grievous Thrash is still bleeding you, top up with Impending Victory before the cones
[광역 피해] After 40%, stay in Defensive Stance through Spirits of the Vale and use Rallying Cry. Press Spell Reflection on cooldown for Lightfall (Holy) and Lightfire (Radiant) damage
Ziekket: [차단] Pummel the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before the revive, and if several group up, stop them together with Shockwave
[우선 처치] Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control, so melt them together with Odyn's Fury (Slayer) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane)
[광역 피해] Rotate Spell Reflection every cooldown for the stacking Lightbloom's Might Holy DoT and Oozing Xylem

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is physical damage that ignores armor, so Spell Reflection does nothing; take it in Defensive Stance
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, Heroic Leap to step on them first
[회피] Clear the snare from Bonespike Slam's spike pools with Berserker Rage (Fearless)
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Pummel into the Winter's Shroud rotation for the Fractured Shivercore, and if you miss, stun it with Storm Bolt to stop the cast
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Frozen Tempest Frost DoT
[회피] If you're snared when you need to dodge Raging Squall, clear it with Berserker Rage (Fearless)
Nalorakk: [위치] When targeted by Echoing Maul, reach the corner used for this set within 4 sec. Use Heroic Leap if it is far, and press Spell Reflection for the 193965 Nature damage as the Echo lands (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Switch to Defensive Stance before Overwhelming Onslaught's three armor-ignoring Physical hits. It is Physical damage, so Spell Reflection does not help

[광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, press Spell Reflection once it is back for the Echoing Fury Nature damage taken while blocking Echoes, and add Rallying Cry (3 min) if you must block several Echoes

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] The first Destabilized is the window with the Concealed Pistol bleed, so Kystia should drop to around 40% here. Stack Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm (Slayer build) in these 20 sec, and reduce the Chaos damage taken every second with Spell Reflection (Topicx)
[차단] Kick your assigned Mirror Images clone's Felstorm with Pummel, and stop grouped clones all at once with Shockwave
[해제] You cannot remove Corroding Spittle (Magic) yourself, so tell a party member who can dispel it, and reduce the Fire damage with Spell Reflection while it is on you
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The second Bloodlust goes out at the start, when the worker pack from the RP is killed together with the boss. Press Recklessness and hit the workers and the boss together with Avatar and Thunder Clap in the Mountain Thane build, or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm in the Slayer build (Topicx)
[위치] During Murder in a Row, if a barrel is far, use Heroic Leap to get behind a Forbidden Freight first. Several players can hide behind one barrel, so pick the closest one
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so take it in Defensive Stance, and use Rallying Cry if a Fel-Infused Freight is still up (Topicx)
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Break the Axe Toss axe next to the boss so Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane build) hits the boss and the axe together

[광역 피해] The third Bloodlust goes out on the second Demonic Rage. The boss takes 30% more damage for these 15 sec, so line up Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Bladestorm (Slayer build) here (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Infernal Crush (Fire) and Demonic Rage (Chaos), and add Rallying Cry if the axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Pummel into the Chaos Bolt rotation. If you are the target, try to reflect it with Spell Reflection; even without a reflect it cuts the damage by 20%

[우선 처치] Damage cooldowns go on the Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns, not the boss. Press Recklessness and melt the adds first with Avatar in the Mountain Thane build or Odyn's Fury in the Slayer build (Topicx)
[제어] Stop the Wild Imp pack's Felfire Burst all at once with Shockwave. Hitting 3 or more cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth (Topicx)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Dark Bloom is the biggest party damage in this fight. Line Rallying Cry (3 min) up with Dark Bloom, and since it is Shadow damage, press Spell Reflection with it (Topicx)
[광역 피해] For Umbral Rupture's Shadow damage, press the Spell Reflection (25 sec) that is back after Dark Bloom
[회피] If there is no room to dodge the orbs from Void Fissure, get out with Heroic Leap
Atroxus: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out when the first Toxic Creeper appears. When a Creeper spawns, melt it right away with Recklessness and Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) or Avatar (Mountain Thane build) (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Monstrous Roar is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so take it in Defensive Stance, and reduce Toxic Aura's Nature damage with Spell Reflection
Charonus: [위치] When targeted by Gravitic Orbs, melee drag the orb to one of the two near Unstable Singularities in front of the boss. If it is far, go first with Heroic Leap, but do not touch the Singularity (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry (3 min) during the orb-dragging phase. Press Spell Reflection for Cosmic Crash's burst and 20 sec Shadow DoT (Topicx)
[회피] Clear Condensed Mass's movement slow with Berserker Rage (Fearless)

[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Serpentine Gust Nature AoE
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Pummel in the Wretched Discharge rotation for Half-Finished Mummy and Finished Mummy, and when two are together, stop them both with Shockwave

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on this boss, so line up Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm (Slayer build) with it at the start, and press Spell Reflection for Awakening Slam's Shadow AoE (Topicx)
[참고] If targeted by Drain Fluids, refill above 90% health with Impending Victory to clear Desiccation
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] The longer Kula lives, the more Whirling Axes pile up, so stack Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm (Slayer build) on Kula and kill her before the fourth set of axes. [차단] Put Pummel in Zanazal's Poison Nova rotation, and press Spell Reflection for Arc Lightning's Nature damage arcing off the tank (Topicx)
[위치] If you are late for the Barrel Through soak, join within 7 yards of the target with Heroic Leap
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar, so stack Recklessness with Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm (Slayer build) on Reban and kill him before 80% (Topicx)
[차단] Put Pummel in Reban's Deathly Roar rotation, and if it is missed and you are feared, break it with Berserker Rage
[광역 피해] Line up Spell Reflection and Rallying Cry with Gilded Destruction's Fire AoE and 15 sec DoT

[광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry in the intermission when the whelps and the shield are up together, and press Spell Reflection for Chillstorm's and Frost Overload's Frost damage (Topicx)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Pummel in Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley rotation, and press Spell Reflection for the stacking Inferno Fire AoE
[우선 처치] Switch to the Firestorm as soon as it appears and kill it before the next Molten Boulder. Line up Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) or a returned Recklessness with the Firestorm (Topicx)
[위치] When the Firestorm dies, get out of Burnout's 20 yard range with Heroic Leap
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka lands, get on her right away with Charge or Heroic Leap and deal damage. After the merge in phase 2, press Recklessness and finish the lower-health boss first (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Interrupting Cloudburst's Nature AoE

[위치] If targeted by Inferno Spit, go to the platform edge on the side of the next Winds of Change direction to drop the pool, and press Spell Reflection when the circle explodes if it is back (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for the Thunder and Lightning soak and Gust Nature damage
[위치] After Gale Force pushes you, Charge or Heroic Leap straight back to keep your damage going
Merektha: [차단] Put Pummel in Toxic Viper's Poison Spit rotation

[제어] When the two A Knot of Snakes targets group up, free them by using Shockwave or Storm Bolt on the knots, and hit the released snakes together with Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane build) (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Serpentstorm's Nature AoE, and line up Rallying Cry since this is the party defensive window (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] Swap to Defensive Stance on your turn to soak the Lightning Spire beam. Galvanized increases physical damage taken by 250%
[광역 피해] Pop Spell Reflection for Galvanized and Induction Nature damage
Avatar of Sethraliss: [차단] Put Pummel in Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock rotation. The Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so a stun cannot replace the kick

격노의 재생력, 가로막기, 개입, 주문 반사, 폭풍망치, 들이치기의 재사용 대기시간이 10%만큼 감소합니다.

적의 주문 시전을 방해하는 데 성공하면 10초 동안 적에게 입히는 피해가 5%만큼 증가합니다.

396749.d:
무모한 희생을 활성화하면 50의 분노를 생성합니다. 또한 무모한 희생이 활성화된 동안 분노의 강타와 피의 갈증이 각각 분쇄의 타격과 피범벅으로 강화됩니다.

분쇄의 타격
추가 피해를 입히며, 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

피범벅
추가 피해를 입히며, 대상에게 상처를 남겨 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 187.26%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다. 피범벅에 영향을 받는 대상에게 피범벅을 사용하면 출혈 효과의 지속시간이 6초만큼 연장됩니다.

424742.d:
외침 능력에 추가 효과가 부여됩니다.

전투의 외침:
전투력이 3%만큼 추가로 증가합니다.

재집결의 함성:
생명력이 2%만큼 증가하고 지속시간은 3초만큼 연장됩니다.

날카로운 고함:
반경이 100%만큼 증가합니다.

광전사의 외침:

위협의 외침:
재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소합니다.

434969.d:
천둥벼락, 분노의 강타, 또는 마무리 일격으로 적에게 피해를 입히면 25%의 확률로 적을 번개로 가격해 (전투력의 232.65%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다.

투신의 지속시간 동안 벼락이 30%만큼 더 자주 발동합니다.

435607.d:
방패 밀쳐내기 및 피의 갈증 사용 시 35%의 확률로 우레 작렬이 부여됩니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.

우레 작렬
다음 천둥벼락이 우레 작렬로 변화하여 (전투력의 234.295%)의 폭풍충격 피해를 입히고 2의 분노를 생성합니다.

436162.d: 폭풍망치가 추가로 2명의 주위 대상에게 적중하고 2초 동안 기절시키지만 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 증가합니다.

437134.d:
투신 시전 시 우레 작렬이 2중첩 부여되고 천둥벼락의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

투신이 활성화되지 않은 동안에는 벼락이 10%의 확률로 4초 동안 투신을 활성화시킵니다.

우레 작렬
다음 천둥벼락이 우레 작렬로 변화하여 폭풍충격 피해를 입힙니다.

444767.d: 주 대상에게 공격 시 15%의 확률로 대상의 방어를 압도하고 학살자의 일격을 발동시켜 (전투력의 840.42%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 집행자 중첩을 얻어 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다. 집행자는 여러 번 중첩됩니다.

444769.d:
학살자의 일격을 3회 사용할 때마다 급살이 부여됩니다.

급살 사용 시 다음 칼날폭풍이 가속화되어 추가로 1회 공격을 가합니다. 최대 3회의 공격을 가합니다. 칼날폭풍의 전체 지속시간은 변경되지 않습니다.

급살이 100%의 확률로 폭풍을 거두는 자를 100%의 효율로 발동시킵니다.

444775.d: 광란이 소용돌이 연마를 통해 3명 이상의 대상에게 적중 시 20%의 확률로 강철의 질풍을 방출하여 주위의 모든 적을 공격해 (전투력의 771.909%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 압도당함 효과를 부여합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

445584.d: 주 대상에게 공격 시 15%의 확률로 대상의 방어를 압도하고 학살자의 일격을 발동시켜 (전투력의 840.42%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 집행자 중첩을 얻어 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력이 3%만큼 증가합니다. 집행자는 여러 번 중첩됩니다.

1244088.m: 특성 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1244088.d: 빠른 속도로 아군 주위의 대상 지점으로 달려가 3미터 내 모든 아군이 받는 피해의 30%를 받습니다. 8초 동안 혹은 이 효과로 [(0.2) * 총 생명력] 이상의 피해를 받을 때까지 지속됩니다.

1265357.d: 소용돌이 연마가 활성화된 동안 광란의 마지막 공격이 지면을 강타하여 대상 주위 8미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 372.289%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1269310.d: 무모한 희생 사용 시 광폭화 3중첩이 부여되고 무모한 희생의 지속시간이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

1270717.d: 칼날폭풍 사용 시 전투 몰입 상태가 되어, 칼날폭풍이 끝난 후 8초 동안 가속이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

1270724.d: 투신의 지속시간 동안 우레 작렬이 투신의 지속시간을 2.0초만큼 증가시킵니다.

1271925.d: 광전사의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼 감소하며, 시전 시 모든 이동 속도 저해 효과를 제거합니다.

1271948.d:
투척 능력의 사정거리가 5미터만큼 증가합니다.

용사의 창, 분쇄의 투척, 격파의 투척의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

분쇄의 투척과 격파의 투척은 플레이어가 아닌 대상을 3초 동안 침묵 상태로 만듭니다.

1280961.d:
태세가 추가 효과를 부여합니다.

광폭 태세
자동 공격 속도가 3%만큼 증가합니다.

방어 태세
자신의 최대 생명력의 20%를 넘는 피해를 입히는 공격을 받으면, 그 공격으로 받는 피해가 15%만큼 감소합니다.

1299025.d: 소용돌이 사용 시 모든 대상에게 분쇄를 부여해 15초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 190.465%)의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots that keep Radiant Spellsower walking toward the tank, and kick Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) with Pummel (15 sec). If a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, stop it with Storm Bolt (20 yd, 4 sec stun) to prevent Frantic Blooming.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust goes out, press Recklessness. The Mountain Thane build adds Avatar and opens the AoE with the 2 Thunder Blast charges from Avatar of the Storm; the Slayer build adds Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm.

[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% magic damage reduction for 5 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec). If the 13 Lashers' melee hits also drop the group low, add Rallying Cry (3 min).
2: [우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher wraps itself in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108, immune to crowd control), the Mountain Thane build breaks it with Wrecking Throw (45 sec, up to 500% extra damage to absorb shields). Storm Bolt and Shockwave do not work while the shield is up.
[차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, kick one with Pummel and stop the other with a Storm Bolt stun.
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Spouting Floret. Its cooldown is 25 sec, so it is back even if you used it on pull 1.
3: [차단] Put Pummel in the Light Bolt Volley interrupt rotation. With 12 Lashers nearby, stop a Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove using Storm Bolt, and if Storm Bolt is down, follow it with Charge (2 charges with Double Time), root it for 1 sec and kill it.
[제어] If both Spellsowers are grouped in front of you and casting together, stop both with Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec stun in a 10 yd frontal cone, range +6 yd with Rumbling Earth).

[우선 처치] On a Lightgorged Lasher with the Lightbloom Pollination shield, the Mountain Thane build throws Wrecking Throw, and the Slayer build makes that Lasher its primary target to break the shield first.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) with Pummel.
[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal cone with knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec), stop it with a Storm Bolt stun (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, then press Recklessness once Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later. The Mountain Thane build pairs it with Avatar, the Slayer build with Odyn's Fury.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Pummel, and if Pummel is free, also kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot.
[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stun both with Shockwave. In the Mountain Thane build, Storm Bolts makes Storm Bolt stun 3 targets (cooldown +10 sec), so it can also stop both.
[참고] While the 5 Spineshield Beetles still have Spiny Shield, every Whirlwind hit returns 4849 Nature damage. Press Spell Reflection while breaking the shields to reduce the reflected damage.
8: [제어] Split the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap between Storm Bolt and Shockwave.
[광역 피해] Timing Spell Reflection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret also reduces the Nature damage returned by Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield by 20%.
[차단] When you have room, kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast) with Pummel.
10: [광역 피해] Warriors cannot dispel Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT). When you see the cast, press Spell Reflection to reduce the Nature damage, and if you are low after the poison, top up with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health).
[우선 처치] When the two Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so the Mountain Thane build breaks them first with Wrecking Throw.

[참고] The adds are cleared first, so use Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane build) or Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) on the Lasher pack and save Recklessness for the Potatoad Matriarch and Potadpole Eggs you engage afterward.
11: [제어] One Pummel cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech. If the three are grouped, stun them all at once with Shockwave. Hitting 3 or more targets cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth. The Mountain Thane build can also stun all three with Storm Bolt.
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
12: [우선 처치] This is the last big pull, so press Recklessness and stack Avatar (Mountain Thane build) or Bladestorm and Odyn's Fury (Slayer build) to break the six Lightgorged Lashers' Lightbloom Pollination shields. The Mountain Thane build throws Wrecking Throw at a shielded Lasher.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Pummel and Storm Bolt, and follow one that flees with Call The Grove using Charge.
[광역 피해] If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap, add Rallying Cry to Spell Reflection.

1: [차단] Each of the two Primal Serpents gets one interrupter. Take one and kick Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical plus 30% haste reduction for 6 sec) with Pummel (15 sec) (Topicx).

[제어] If the Ravenous Claws attack speed stacks on the 7 Ravenous Descendants start hurting the tank, stun them all with Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec stun) to break the stacks. Hitting 3 or more targets cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] Hit Ritual Chieftain first. Topicx treats this as a cooldown pull, so press Recklessness, with Avatar in the Mountain Thane build or Odyn's Fury in the Slayer build.

[광역 피해] While the Chieftain lives, Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 healing absorb) is the hardest hit in this pack. Switch to Defensive Stance if you are low, and use Rallying Cry (3 min) if the whole group is low too (Topicx).
[차단] One interrupter covers Piercing Hiss from the single Primal Serpent. If it is yours, kick it with Pummel.
3: [차단] All three Primal Serpents cast, so no interrupt can be missed. Take one with Pummel and stop another with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun) (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Topicx also uses cooldowns on this pull. If the Recklessness (1.5 min) from pull 2 is not back yet, open the AoE with Odyn's Fury (Slayer build, 45 sec) or Thunder Clap (Mountain Thane build) and kill Ritual Chieftain first.
[참고] Unstable Totem (29095 Nature every 2 sec) keeps going while the Chieftain is in combat, so reduce it with Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% magic damage reduction for 5 sec).
4: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents and kick Piercing Hiss with Pummel.

[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Unstable Totem's Nature damage. If the Blood Sacrifice healing absorb keeps you from filling up, clear the absorb and top up with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health).
5: [광역 피해] At 103 trash count this is the largest pull on the route. Press Recklessness, adding Avatar in the Mountain Thane build or Bladestorm and Odyn's Fury in the Slayer build, and melt Ritual Chieftain first.

[광역 피해] When the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots (67888 Nature plus 48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec) overlap with Blood Sacrifice, healing through it is hard (Topicx). Use Spell Reflection for Paralyzing Shots and Rallying Cry for Blood Sacrifice.
[차단] Kick Piercing Hiss from one of the two Primal Serpents with Pummel.
7: [차단] If High Evolutionist's Envenom lands right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle, the DoT and the AoE overlap. Always kick that cast with Pummel (Topicx).

[제어] Stop Evolve (6 sec channel) with a Storm Bolt stun. If it finishes, the mob gains a shield (absorbs 250045) and crowd control immunity. Once the shield is up, the Mountain Thane build breaks it with Wrecking Throw (45 sec, up to 500% extra damage to absorb shields).
[광역 피해] Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec) is Physical damage, so Spell Reflection does not reduce it. Switch to Defensive Stance to take it.
8: [제어] The 4 Bloodletters leave a blood pool with every melee swing. Stun them together with Shockwave and hit 3 or more to cut its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.
[광역 피해] Take Rattle's 5 sec Physical AoE in Defensive Stance, and top up with Impending Victory afterward if you are low.
9: [우선 처치] High Evolutionists must die before their second Mass Envenom. Press Recklessness and hit the Evolutionists first. If one has the Evolve shield, the Mountain Thane build breaks it with Wrecking Throw (Topicx).
[차단] The far-left Evolutionist is pulled in by a ranged interrupter. Kick the near Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Pummel and stop Evolve with Storm Bolt (Topicx).
11: [차단] Each of the 4 Evolutionists gets an assigned interrupter. Take one and kick Mass Envenom with Pummel (Topicx).

[제어] If several start Evolve together, stun the front group at once with Shockwave. In the Mountain Thane build, Storm Bolts makes Storm Bolt stun 3 nearby targets, so use it on the ones Shockwave missed.
[우선 처치] If a missed Evolve leaves one with a shield (absorbs 250045), the Mountain Thane build breaks it with Wrecking Throw, and the Slayer build makes it the primary target.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest. Press Recklessness, adding Avatar in the Mountain Thane build or Odyn's Fury in the Slayer build (Topicx).
[광역 피해] When you get Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), press Spell Reflection and move to the spot the tank pinged.
[제어] Stun the two Blades of the Altar with Storm Bolt to stop Laced Edge teleports, and hold the Hatchlings from the eggs with Shockwave so the group does not have to scatter (Topicx).
13: [우선 처치] Kill Ula'tek's Chosen first and kick every Mass Envenom with Pummel. Line Recklessness up on the Chosen.

[참고] The 6 Living Venoms deal Venom Burst party damage when they die. Do not dump Bladestorm (Slayer build) or Avatar's Thunder Blasts (Mountain Thane build) on the Living Venoms as soon as they appear. In the Topicx video, melting them all at once nearly wiped the group.
[제어] During Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every 1 sec for 9 sec), stun the two Blades of the Altar with Shockwave or Storm Bolt to stop their teleport attacks (Topicx).
14: [광역 피해] Use Rallying Cry for the 9 sec Toxic Surge AoE and press Spell Reflection with it (Topicx).
[제어] During Toxic Surge, stun a Blade of the Altar with Storm Bolt to stop Laced Edge, and kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Pummel (Topicx).
15: [차단] Kick Piercing Hiss from one of the two Primal Serpents with Pummel.
[제어] Four Blades of the Altar join this pull. Stun them with Shockwave while they are grouped to delay Laced Edge teleports. Hitting all four cuts its cooldown by 15 sec through Rumbling Earth.
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection for Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots Nature DoT.
16: [우선 처치] Kill Ula'tek's Chosen right away and finish it before the second Toxic Surge. Press Recklessness on the Chosen and kick Mass Envenom with Pummel (Topicx).

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back and overlap with Toxic Surge. Reduce Toxic Surge's Nature damage with Spell Reflection and take Blood Sacrifice's Physical damage in Defensive Stance. If the Rallying Cry (3 min) used on pull 14 is back, use it here.
[제어] Stun the two Blades of the Altar with Storm Bolt or Shockwave during Toxic Surge.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull. Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard are pulled together, so press Recklessness with Avatar in the Mountain Thane build or Odyn's Fury and Bladestorm in the Slayer build (Topicx).

[우선 처치] Bribed Captain's Deep Corruption increases nearby mobs' damage by 25% and reduces the AoE damage they take by 25%. Make the Captain your primary target, kill it first, then move to the Guard (Topicx).
[참고] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (38793 Physical plus 155172 bleed over 8 sec) lands on you, top up with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health). Warriors cannot dispel Heartstop Poison.
2: [차단] Each Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) gets one interrupter (Topicx). Take one and kick it with Pummel (15 sec), or stop it with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun) if Pummel is down.
[차단] When you have room, kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles channel with Pummel.
4: [차단] Kick the Fel Missiles of the Felonious Mage that runs out of the door with Pummel.

[광역 피해] Heartstop Poison from 4 Street Sneaks stacks quickly (Topicx). Warriors cannot dispel poison, so press Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% magic damage reduction for 5 sec) for the Nature DoT and call your poison dispeller.
5: [우선 처치] Kill Massive Felwyrm first (Topicx). Over-infused deals 38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec, so press Recklessness to melt it quickly.
[광역 피해] Press Spell Reflection when Corroding Spittle (Magic, 30 sec Fire DoT) comes at you. Topicx blocks it with a reflect. If it lands, ask for a dispel.
[회피] When the dying Massive Felwyrm casts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), leave the radius with Heroic Leap.
8: [차단] Warriors cannot remove enrages, so always kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd control immunity) with Pummel. Stop Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Storm Bolt.

[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire to the group every 1 sec), press Recklessness and focus it down right away. Reduce the Fire damage with Spell Reflection meanwhile.
[회피] Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd) easily catches melee. When you see the cast, step out beyond 12 yd.
9: [광역 피해] If you are the Drain Life target of Corrupted Warlock, use a defensive so the warlock does not heal a lot (Topicx). Press Spell Reflection and Defensive Stance, and top up with Impending Victory afterward.
